description:
## What

Apply the opi-y0a.3 pattern to branch summary / `navigate_tree`. Mirrors upstream `AgentSession.navigateTree` (line 2675) — after the persistence work, `this.agent.state.messages = sessionContext.messages` (line 2836).

Specifically: after `do_navigate_tree` persists a `BranchSummary` entry (or just moves the leaf with no summary), Coder.Loop calls `Agent.set_messages(agent_pid, new_chain)` where `new_chain = SessionStore.path(:leaf, to: :latest_compaction)`.

Today the post-navigate handler already updates `state.path` via `Store.path` (opi-qy9.3). This adds the symmetric `Agent.set_messages` call.

## Why

Same reason as opi-y0a.3: the host owns the working buffer. After navigation, the Agent's transcript must reflect the new chain or the next turn will run on stale messages.

## Files

- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/loop.ex` — `:navigate_tree` handler: after the existing path reset, also call `Agent.set_messages`.

## Out of scope

- `do_navigate_tree`'s internal logic (extension hooks, summarization decision tree, etc.) — unchanged.

## Done when

- After `Coder.navigate_tree/2`, `Agent`'s `loop.messages` matches the new path.
- Existing navigation tests still pass.
- New test verifies post-navigate Agent transcript equals `[BranchSummaryMessage | tail]` when summarization happened, or equals the new-leaf-prefix chain when no summary.
title: Branch summary and navigate_tree mirror the compaction pattern
